modules.name: M1 通知插件：测试发送接口与投递状态语义
modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-plugin-notification 提供的通知测试发送 HTTP 契约、目标发现、用户隔离的投递状态查询与 Settings 通知日志页，以及其 Skill 对 accepted/retrying/failed/unknown 语义的说明。
modules.limitations: 评审为只读：未运行该插件或任何测试；结论基于冻结快照的 dist 实现与 Skill 文本。测试入口的渠道隔离是否足够由 M2/F5 继续评估。

requirements.need: 提供一个最小的测试发送入口，把一次测试通知发往明确隔离的测试收件端（不触达真实客户或真实群组）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供测试发送 HTTP 契约与目标描述符：GET /test/targets 暴露安全字段元数据，POST /test/send 走与正常发送相同的 send() 输入，请求体由严格 schema 校验；应用负责选择隔离渠道并钉住收件人。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用已认证会话并携带 x-nocobase-notification-test: 1 调用三个测试端点，POST /send 额外需要 notification:test send 权限；只提供目标要求的字段，凭据留在服务端（E9/E10）。
requirements.actualUsage: app 的 api.ts 以固定测试头调用 targets/send，页面把收件人钉为当前登录用户或保留的 .invalid 邮箱；测试目标由 app/server/config/notification.ts 中的 test-inbox 与 test-failure 定义。

requirements.need: 在既有的通知日志页查看最终投递状态，复用 Notification 与其 Provider，而不是另写发送通道。
requirements.responsibility: 框架自带 Settings > Notifications > Logs 页面，由 page:notification.logs access 授权，并暴露 Notification/Delivery/Attempt 的诊断数据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 注册核心通知插件后，从测试页面链接到既有日志页；用 status 与 deliveries/attempts 读取最终结果，而不是把发送返回值当作送达（E10/E12）。
requirements.actualUsage: 测试页面链接到 /settings/notifications/logs；QA 在该页展开通知，读到 Source、Status 与 Deliveries/Attempts 明细，并另行核对收件箱实际接收。

requirements.need: 区分 queued/accepted 与最终送达，失败时保留真实原因，未配置渠道不能被标成成功。
requirements.responsibility: 框架在 Notification/Delivery/Attempt 三层上定义 accepted（Provider 已受理）、retrying、failed、unknown 语义，并把每条 Delivery 独立处理；idempotencyKey 冲突会被拒绝，重复键返回 deduplicated 快照。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 把 accepted 视为未最终送达，用 logs 的 Delivery/Attempt 终态或独立收件端证据确认；unknown 不得直接重试（E11/E12）。
requirements.actualUsage: B01 中 in-app 记录由 accepted 推进到 completed，并通过 durable 收件箱项 deliveryId 与诊断记录交叉核对；B02 中 SMTP 记录为 failed 且保留 ENOTFOUND 原因。

requirementFit.reason: 测试发送入口、用户隔离的状态查询、严格请求校验与既有日志页共同直接满足本次需求；仅因渠道隔离留给应用侧而没有服务端 test-only 约束扣少量分。

usability.reason: 三个端点语义清晰、错误码可读，Skill 明确写出认证、测试头与权限要求；代价是调用者必须先知道专用测试头才能用同一套 API。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 与参考文档按概念到发送到诊断给出阅读顺序，并显式说明 accepted 不等于已读、unknown 的处置与失败保留要求，与该 Agent 实际引用一致。

design.reason: 注册表、管理器与渠道管理器分层清晰：请求契约独立、目标描述符只暴露安全字段、发号入幂等键、每条 Delivery 独立并保留租约/超时/重试生命周期。

reliability.reason: 实现层同时具备认证与授权中间件、测试头门禁、notification:test send 权限、幂等键冲突拒绝，以及把 submission_unknown 归为 unknown、仅在 same_provider 且未耗尽尝试时才重试的终态处理。

modules.name: M2 Provider 与 Skill：SMTP 受控失败与 in-app 持久化收件箱

targets.name: @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-providers
entrypoints: email Channel definition test fields + toSendInput

modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-providers 的 SMTP 失败分类、@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app 的持久化收件箱 Provider，以及 in-app Skill 对持久化与用户隔离的约束。
modules.limitations: 未实际发起网络发送；SMTP 结论基于分类实现与 QA 记录的 ENOTFOUND 观测，未验证真实可达服务器上的成功路径。

requirements.need: 提供一个确定的、可离线的可控失败条件，并在诊断中保留真实失败原因，不把失败或未配置渠道标成成功。
requirements.responsibility: SMTP Provider 把 sendMail 异常映射为 category/code/disposition 并保留原始错误码与信息；默认 maxAttempts=1 时 pre_submission 的 same_provider 失败落终态 failed。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用保留域名或不可达主机配置一个测试渠道，读 deliveries[].lastError 而不是只看 HTTP 202（E13/E14）。
requirements.actualUsage: app 用 test-failure 指向 notification-test.invalid；QA 记录 Status=failed、Attempts=1 与 ENOTFOUND 原因，未标成功。

requirements.need: 让正常测试真正到达一个与真实客户/分组隔离的收件端，以便把已受理与已送达分开。
requirements.responsibility: in-app Provider 在写入 inbox 前通过 recipientExists 校验收件用户，写入持久收件项并返回 accepted；缺失用户返回不可重试的 recipient 失败且不写记录。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 注册 in-app 渠道，把测试收件人钉为当前登录用户，用 durable 收件箱 API 读取条目并与 deliveryId 交叉核对（E18/E19）。
requirements.actualUsage: test-inbox 使用 in-app Provider；B01 经 durable inbox API 读到收件项并匹配 deliveryId 9da97dbe。

requirementFit.reason: SMTP 分类给出确定且保留原因的失败，in-app Provider 给出持久、用户隔离的真实接收，两者直接覆盖正常与受控失败两条需求。

usability.reason: Provider 配置与测试字段由定义自动生成，收件人校验错误信息清晰；但测试字段与错误分类的对应关系主要靠读实现，调用者需自行推断。

agentFriendliness.reason: in-app Skill 明确持久化与非目标，但 SMTP 的 ENOTFOUND/EAI_AGAIN 到 pre_submission 的具体映射未在 Skill 中给出，Agent 需读实现才能预判受控失败结果。

design.reason: 两个 Provider 都声明 idempotency 能力并返回带 category/disposition 的结构化结果；in-app 在写库前做收件人存在性校验，失败不留半成品记录。

reliability.reason: 失败分类区分 pre_submission 与 submission_unknown，重试归属绑定原 Provider；in-app 的缺失收件人不可重试、存储失败可重试，避免把未知状态当作成功。

modules.scope: 评估 @nocobase/app-client 的应用作用域客户端/服务钩子、@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 的会话上下文、@nocobase/i18n 的翻译钩子，以及 app/AGENTS.md 与 nocobase-app-development Skill 对路由、前端 workflow 与在应用内构建功能的指引。

findings.title: 通知测试发送入口自带鉴权、测试头与权限门禁，并持久化可由创建者查询的记录
findings.detail: 测试路由对全部端点要求认证并强制 x-nocobase-notification-test: 1，POST /send 另需 notification:test send 权限；sendTest 用绑定创建者 userId 的 notification-test source 记录，getTestStatus 只返回同一 sourceReferenceId 的通知。
findings.impact: 应用无需自行搭建测试发送入口即可获得隔离、可审计且按用户可见的测试链路，降低把测试消息误发到业务通道或泄露他人记录的风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该契约；如需扩大使用范围，优先补充文档而非弱化门禁。

findings.title: 投递模型明确区分受理与最终送达，并保留 unknown 与重试归属语义
findings.detail: Skill 把 Notification/Delivery/Attempt 分层，说明 accepted 只代表 Provider 受理，retrying 记录 nextRunAt，failed 为终态可手动重试，unknown 必须先用外部证据核实；实现侧 channel-manager 将 submission_unknown 记为 unknown，仅在 same_provider 且未耗尽 maxAttempts 时重试，否则落终态 failed。
findings.impact: 正好支撑“accepted 不等于已送达”这一验收要点，并使受控失败不会破坏真实原因。

findings.title: in-app 持久化收件箱与 SMTP 失败分类分别提供真实的接收与失败证据
findings.detail: in-app Provider 在写入前用 recipientExists 校验收件用户，缺失用户返回不可重试的 recipient 失败且不写记录；SMTP Provider 把 sendMail 异常映射为 category/code/disposition，ENOTFOUND/EAI_AGAIN 归为 pre_submission（same_provider），默认 maxAttempts=1 时落终态 failed 并保留原始错误码与信息。
findings.impact: 使 B01 能拿到独立的接收证据、B02 能拿到真实失败原因，而不是依赖 HTTP 受理值或通用错误文案。

findings.title: 模板提交 e318f4e 在 app/AGENTS.md 引入多余空行，使 format:check 失败并消耗一次修复
findings.detail: 框架提交 e318f4e（test: add opt-in controlled failed delivery smoke #404）在 app/AGENTS.md 的 ## Controlled failed-delivery smoke 前新增了两个空行；prettier . --check '!.github/**' 因此标记 AGENTS.md，verify-1 的 format:check 以 exit 1 结束，修复轮随后只做删除一个空行的空白修改。
findings.impact: 从模板生成的干净应用无法通过其自身的 format:check，把与业务无关的格式问题变成必须消耗修复预算的失败，并让 Agent 面对“能否修改框架指引文件”的不确定。
findings.suggestedChange: 在模板源头修正 e318f4e 引入的空行，并让模板 CI 对 app/AGENTS.md 运行 prettier --check，避免把格式缺陷带进每个新应用。

findings.title: 测试发送入口默认暴露所有带 test 定义的启用渠道，缺少服务端 test-only 约束
findings.detail: registry.testTargets 返回任何 enabled 且其 Provider messageType 定义了 test 的渠道，manager.resolveTestTarget 只校验渠道名在 listTestTargets 内；服务端没有把渠道标记为 test-only 的开关，也未在服务端强制排除业务渠道。本次隔离靠应用给渠道加 test- 前缀并在客户端 isTestChannel 过滤，服务端 /test/send 仍接受任何已列出的渠道。
findings.impact: 拥有 notification:test send 权限的调用者可在带 test 定义的业务渠道上发起真实外部发送，隔离强度取决于应用自觉而非框架保证。
findings.suggestedChange: 为渠道或测试面增加 test-only 标记或白名单（例如配置里显式声明 testTargets，或渠道上的 test 开关），并在 resolveTestTarget 中拒绝未标记渠道；或在 Skill 中明确要求应用在服务端强制隔离。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Repaired the notification-test task's only observed failure: the repository-wide Prettier check failed on the template's AGENTS.md, which aborted the quality pipeline before typecheck/test/build. Removed the extra blank line introduced by framework commit e318f4e and re-verified the feature's scoped tests.

blockers.title: format:check fails on the template's own AGENTS.md
blockers.symptom: `pnpm format:check` (`prettier . --check '!.github/**'`) reported `[warn] AGENTS.md` and exited 1. Because `check` is `lint && format:check && typecheck && test && build`, and `format:auto` (format-changes.mjs) only formats files the agent's patch changed, the untouched AGENTS.md was never normalized, so the pipeline aborted before typecheck/test/build ever ran.
blockers.rootCause: Framework/template commit e318f4e appended the 'Controlled failed-delivery smoke' section to AGENTS.md with two blank lines before the `##` heading; Prettier allows only one. AGENTS.md is a generated template file the factory overlay deliberately leaves untouched, and it was not part of the application patch, so no automatic formatting step corrected it.
blockers.resolution: Removed the single extra blank line in AGENTS.md (whitespace-only). Verified with `npx prettier . --check '!.github/**'` (all matched files formatted) and re-ran the feature's scoped tests: `tests/logic/notification-test-target.test.ts`, `tests/logic/config.test.ts` (10 passed) and the `app-server.test.ts` case 'delivers a notification test to an isolated inbox and records a controlled failure' (passed, including normal in-app delivery and recorded controlled SMTP failure).

improvements.title: Format the generated AGENTS.md in the refresh baseline
improvements.detail: The refresh overlay intentionally keeps the generated AGENTS.md untouched, so a formatting defect committed upstream to that file survives into every generated application and fails the repository-wide `format:check` on inspection. `format-changes.mjs` cannot repair it because the file is not part of the agent's patch.
improvements.suggestedChange: Normalize the template's AGENTS.md (run Prettier over it) as part of the template refresh, or include it in the files `format-changes.mjs` is allowed to rewrite on a repair retry.

The core package exposes `GET /api/notifications/test/targets`, `POST /api/notifications/test/send`, and `GET /api/notifications/test/:id/status`. evidence.observation: 文档定义 Notification/Delivery/Attempt 分层，说明 accepted 仅代表 Provider 受理、retrying/failed/unknown 的含义与重试绑定原始渠道与 Provider 标识。
evidence.excerpt:
A Notification is one logical send identified by `idempotencyKey`. Each Channel and native recipient produces an independent Delivery. Each Provider submission creates an Attempt. All entries in `messages` execute; one failed delivery does not stop the others. The runtime preserves queues, timeouts, leases, automatic retries, manual retry audits, status queries, and realtime inbox invalidations.

`accepted` means the Provider accepted the submission, not that the recipient read it. Known transient failures can schedule a same-Provider retry. `retrying` means the next attempt is scheduled and `nextRunAt` records its earliest execution time. `failed` is a terminal known failure that may be manually retried. `unknown` means submission may have succeeded and must be checked with external Provider evidence before a new logical send. A retry remains bound to the original Channel name and Provider identifier. Removing, disabling, or changing that Provider prevents rerouting.

A Provider can request same-Provider retry. Once the configured attempt limit is exhausted, the Delivery becomes terminal failed. The runtime does not fail over to another Provider.

### Partial

Treat every Delivery independently. Identify exactly which recipient/Channel/Provider combinations were accepted and which failed. A new send for only failed combinations is a new Notification and requires duplicate-risk review.

### Unknown

Do not retry an unknown Delivery directly. Use Provider message id when available, external Provider dashboards, target inbox/group evidence, and timestamps to determine whether submission happened. If proof remains unavailable, report an indeterminate external effect. If evidence confirms that no message was submitted, create a new logical Notification with the original business idempotency policy.

`auth` controls browser navigation only: `required` for signed-in pages, `guest` for sign-in and registration, `optional` for pages that work either way. It is not server security. An endpoint the page calls enforces its own authentication independently.

Use `defineSettingsRoutes()` for administrative pages, which mount under `/settings`, and `defineDevRoutes()` for development-only pages, which mount under `/dev` and are absent from a production build. Do not repeat `/settings` or `/dev` in the path. `defineDevRoutes()` is a build boundary, not a permission boundary: a page that must be restricted in production is a settings route with `authz`, enforced by the server.

**Declare navigation on the route.** App, Settings and Dev menus read `navigation: { title: 'navigation.orders' }`; titles resolve in the owning locale namespace. Add the translation in `client/locales/`. Refine resources remain for CRUD and do not add menu entries.

Use recursive groups to organize menus; their path is optional. Pages may also have children, but must manually render `Outlet`. For URL-addressable dialogs and drawers, declare the child in `defineAppRoutes()` in `client/routes.ts`, place the owning page's `Outlet`, then render `RouteDialog` or `RouteDrawer`. Call `useRouteOverlay()` only from a descendant rendered inside the overlay, including its footer, never from the page returning the wrapper. # Frontend development workflow

This is the entry point for the application's frontend work: read it before writing or changing anything under `client/` — pages, components, styles or copy. It covers only which workflow to follow, what to do at each step, and what counts as done. It says which changes take the full workflow (write a design file and review it once, then run one independent acceptance review after development), which can be a quick change (edit directly and run static checks only), and which parts of `ui-guidelines.md` and `frontend-dev.md` to read at each step. What the interface should look like is in `ui-guidelines.md`; how to write the code is in `frontend-dev.md`. Paths in this document are relative to its own directory: `ui-guidelines.md` and `frontend-dev.md` sit beside it, the topic references are under `references/`, and the record templates are under `templates/`.

## Choosing a workflow

Decide before you start, and say in one sentence in your reply which workflow you are following and why.

| Workflow      | When it applies                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Full workflow | Any one of: a new page; a new complete interaction (a create/edit flow, a detail drawer, a multi-step operation); a change to the page structure or main interactions; one change that touches the UI of several pages; the user asks to see the design first |
| Quick change  | None of the above applies. For example: changing copy; adjusting styling details; adding a button, a column, a form field or a filter to an existing page; fixing a UI bug; a refactor that changes neither appearance nor behavior                           |

When unsure, explain the difference in one sentence (the full workflow adds a design, a design review and an independent acceptance review) and let the user choose.

## Quick change

1. Read `frontend-dev.md` and the references under `references/` related to the change. When the change affects how the interface looks or behaves, also read the relevant guidelines in `ui-guidelines.md`, and at minimum check the relevant items of the "Review checklist" at its end.
2. Follow how the page is already written: keep components, spacing and copy style consistent with what surrounds the change.
3. Run static checks on the changed files only: `pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`, `pnpm exec eslint --max-warnings 0 <files>`, `pnpm exec prettier --check <files>`.

Ordinary tasks and evaluation samples share the ceilings in `.github/scripts/task-policy.mjs`: five repair attempts, three observations of an identical failure per criterion/check, at most one five-hour Handoff, and ten hours of active implementation/repair/QA time. An evaluation plan can only tighten these limits. Pipeline state carries counters, failure fingerprints and elapsed time across handoffs and explicit recoveries; never clear them to get a task through.

A terminal limit saves `task-diagnostic.json` and `task-diagnostic.md`, preserves the patch and raw evidence, and runs at most one additional fifteen-minute read-only diagnosis using the independent reviewer. This cleanup cannot resume repairs, dispatch another continuation, or authorize final verification. Failed tasks still publish reports and create or update a build PR marked failed when a safe code diff exists. They may attempt preview packaging and deployment once without restarting repair or QA; preview failure does not block the report or PR or change the failed task status. Missing patches or empty diffs must be reported explicitly rather than fabricating a PR. Stopped checkpoints are not recoverable. Reject direct GitHub Re-run attempts for implementation/repair: they start fresh runners without restoring the previous attempt. Use explicit checkpoint recovery in a new Run for recoverable failures. Attribute framework, Skill, template, application, factory and environment issues from evidence; repeated failures alone are not proof of a NocoBase3 defect. Preserve unknown causes and incomplete diagnoses.

## Controlled failed-delivery smoke

The task workflow's opt-in failure_smoke dispatch input exercises failed publication without model calls or business QA. It requires a fresh, open Issue carrying factory:external, factory:failure-smoke, and the <!-- factory-failure-smoke:v1 --> disclosure. Do not use recovery or GitHub Re-run for this mode. The pinned code-only fixture comes from Issue #400 / PR #401; it carries its source SHA and patch digest and never copies earlier QA verdicts or screenshots. The agent job deliberately fails before QA; the existing failed PR, report, packaging and deployment jobs must handle it unchanged. Do not merge its application PR or describe successful preview deployment as successful business acceptance.
